items.text: Archie is on screen.
No one is on screen except: Archie.
Archie is seated on the bench seat opposite the camera, matching his position in the S7 image.
Archie looks the same as in the sprite master: same face, hair, and clothes.
The man at the bar is gone, with no one standing or sitting at the bar where he was.
A barman stands behind the counter wiping it, small and soft.
The far couple are standing or mid-motion putting their coats on, small and soft.
Archie leans forward on his forearms, with his arms resting on the table and his torso angled toward the camera.
Archie looks straight into the camera, not down, aside, or at the food.
Archie's eyes are still slightly red, but not streaming.
Archie's eyebrows are slightly raised, and his expression is calm and expectant, waiting for an answer, not performing, smiling broadly, or angry.
Archie's pint is pushed to one side and mostly drunk.
The carrier bag sits beside Archie.
On the near side there is a half-drunk pint and a chips basket that is half eaten.
The pub room is otherwise unchanged from the blank plate, with the same furniture, layout and image size.
No money, cash or calc is visible on the table or in anyone's hands.
No legible text or logos anywhere in the image.
No player face is shown (the player is never seen).
Nothing story-critical sits in the bottom ~10% of the image.
The focal point survives the small-phone crop.
